# Reconcile Merged PRs

The 'reconcile' command updates the knowledge base by catching up on any merged pull requests that were missed since the last compilation. This ensures that the knowledge base reflects the latest changes made to the repository.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/cli.py` — `knowledge_compiler.cli.reconcile_cmd`
